rationale: Rahul is deploying robotic systems for agricultural field labor at AgRobotics, and Oliver brings deep expertise in computer vision and large language models—both critical technologies for advancing autonomous agricultural robots. Oliver's background building AI systems at Amazon, ObEN, and Kuaishou, combined with his technical stack in computer vision and PyTorch, could directly support AgRobotics' engineering challenges in robotic perception and autonomy.
intro_message: Rahul, meet Oliver Liu — a senior AI engineer with computer vision expertise who's worked on autonomous systems at Amazon and could be a valuable technical sounding board for AgRobotics' robotic deployment challenges.
